'''Lernayin Artsakh FC''' ({{langx|hy|Լեռնային Արցախ Ֆուտբոլային Ակումբ}}) is an [[association football]] club formerly based in [[Stepanakert]], breakaway [[Republic of Artsakh]] but is registered in the town of [[Vayk]], Vayots Dzor Province, [[Armenia]]. The club was founded in 1927 in [[Soviet Azerbaijan]] and its current name translates from Armenian as "''Mountainous Artsakh''".<ref>{{cite web|title=Armenia 2002 Premier League|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/arme02.html|website=RSSSF.com|publisher=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|accessdate=24 February 2016}}</ref><ref>[https://www.thesportsdb.com/team/140689-Lernayin-Artsakh Lernayin Artsakh]</ref>"}}
